ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, in the quadrilateral $ABCD$, $\angle ABD = \angle BCD = 90^\circ$, and $DB$ bisects $\angle ADC$. If $CD = 6$ and $AD = 8$, what is the length of $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $DB$ bisects $\angle ADC$,\\
thus $\angle ADB=\angle BDC$,\\
since $\angle ABD=\angle BCD=90^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\triangle ADB\sim \triangle BDC$,\\
hence $\frac{AD}{BD}=\frac{BD}{CD}$,\\
given that $CD=6$, $AD=8$,\\
thus $\frac{8}{BD}=\frac{BD}{6}$,\\
solving yields: $BD=\boxed{4\sqrt{3}}$.
